releaseName: Clearer Premium note in the Google Play app
notes: In the Google Play app, buying Premium only works when the app runs in Chrome. If your phone opens DebtFree in another browser, like Edge or Samsung Internet, the app now says so and explains how to switch, instead of showing no way to buy.
The Google Play app no longer says Premium "isn’t sold in the Google Play version yet" when the buy button is slow to load. It now says what is happening.
